clue.text: Panic rises involving unknown old 14

definitions.note: 14 is EQUINE, standing here for a horse, so an old horse

indicators.note: in a down clue a word that rises is read from the bottom upwards, so panic is turned round

parts.note: a flap is a state of panic
re means concerning or involving
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: Fear mounts over something unknown and ancient, like a ghost story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rises' turns FLAP upwards to PALF. Throughout this puzzle the cross-reference 14 (EQUINE) stands in for 'horse'.
explanation.definitionFit: A palfrey was a gentle riding horse of the Middle Ages, often ridden by ladies, so it is an old kind of mount.

clue.text: Removal of smeared stain from novel installations leaves a 14
